confounding_traps.note: order_month's WH1 boost is a genuine summer (Jun-Aug) effect, deliberately disjoint from pattern E04's winter [12,1,2] window.

A proxy/mediator trap, not a pure non-causal assignment artifact like ET01/ET02/ET04: acquisition_channel has zero direct effect of its own, but it does causally shift discount_pct (a real, independently-discoverable DECISION_TIME feature), which then genuinely reduces margin. Tests whether a candidate condition correctly attributes the effect to discount_pct rather than to the correlated channel proxy.
